title: MoveBench v0 — Our Label Dataset Characterization
source: self-labeled technique dataset (SQLite), expert-curated instructional + competition grappling corpus
method: Deterministic SQL aggregation over the label dataset SQLite + ontology string/semantic mapping. No model inference. Counts cross-checked against shared/evidence-ledger.md (section 6).

corpus_totals.note: video_hashtags and clip(timestamp)_hashtags draw from the same 1,653-tag vocabulary.

label_text.note: Every clip carries a free-text expert description (coaching prose), not just tags.

tags_per_clip.distribution_note: Unimodal, peak at 9-11 tags/clip; right tail to 40. See histogram in .md.

clips_per_video.distribution_note: Long right tail: most videos have 1-15 clips; two extreme-length compilation videos hold 135 and 139 clips.

top_clip_tags_note: Top clip-tag list shrunk from 30 to 28 entries: two athlete-name tags (person-name hashtags) were removed for privacy. Counts of the remaining technique/position/metadata tags are unchanged.

semantic_categorization.interpretation: Exact ontology string-match covers only 11.6% of tag instances because the corpus uses a far richer free-form hashtag vocabulary (1,653 distinct) than the ~91-term ontology. A semantic pass (concept-word containment) shows ~53.5% of tag instances are technique/position-relevant and map conceptually onto the ontology families; the remaining ~23% are explicit metadata (event/source/modality/athlete) and ~23% are finer-grained free-form concepts not yet in the v0 vocabulary.

ontology_coverage.takeaway: The ontology's 18 macro positions are well-attested (14/18 macro ids appear by exact id/alias; the rest appear via free-form synonyms). The corpus vocabulary is ~18x larger than the v0 ontology, so v0 ontology expansion (mapping the high-frequency free-form technique tags) is the main data-curation lever.

athlete_event_disjoint.rationale: channel = instructor/athlete/event source; channel-disjoint prevents same-athlete or same-event leakage across train/val/test.

leave_one_video_out.definition: train on 429 videos, evaluate on the held-out 1; repeat 430x. Channel-aware LOVO additionally removes all same-channel videos from the train fold.
leave_one_video_out.v0_note: v0 has a single annotated match; LOVO degenerates to 1 held-out fold until more matches are annotated

v0_seed.description: Public v0 seed = single expert-annotated public no-gi competition match (mb_v0_0001).

production_candidate_pool.description: System-scale production corpus the v0 seed and candidate clips were drawn/triaged from (private, not release-cleared).

caveats: Exact ontology-to-tag mapping is intentionally strict (normalized string match); the 11.6% instance coverage is a floor, not a ceiling. Semantic coverage (~53.5%) is an estimate from concept-word containment, labeled as such.

channel is used as an athlete/event-disjoint proxy; it is not a perfect athlete identifier (one channel may feature multiple athletes; one athlete may appear across channels). The split is disjoint by channel, which is the strongest available leakage control without per-athlete labels.
Median tags/clip (11) and median clips/video (9) computed by ordered offset; mean values are exact.
v0 LOVO is degenerate (single annotated match); reported as a protocol for the 430-video corpus once more matches are annotated.
The 50-video production prediction slice is tautological (GT==prediction); excluded from any accuracy claim per evidence-ledger 9.6.
